personal.name: Syed Burhan Ahmed
personal.title: AI Engineer, Researcher & Technical Mentor
personal.tagline: AI Engineer specializing in Generative AI & Computer Vision
personal.bio: AI Engineer specializing in Generative AI, NLP, and Computer Vision. Experienced with Python, PyTorch, YOLOv11, LangChain, and real-time ML pipelines, delivering production-grade systems for education, healthcare, and enterprise use cases.
personal.closingBio: Open to collaborating on challenging, impact-driven projects. Whether it’s deployable computer vision systems, intelligent agents, or mentoring engineers, the focus is on building reliable AI that solves real-world problems.
story: Currently a final-year Artificial Intelligence undergraduate at UMT, working on end-to-end deep learning and full-stack solutions—from custom YOLOv11 deployments for real-time detection to retrieval-augmented (RAG) lecture agents and memory-driven conversational bots.

Across projects, the emphasis is on production-quality code, clear ML explainability, and measurable value for users and stakeholders. Leadership experience includes guiding student teams, conducting workshops, and mentoring on advanced computer vision, NLP, and workflow automation.

Outside of deployment work, time goes into open-source contributions, sharing experiments on platforms like Hugging Face, Kaggle, and GitHub, and documenting the AI journey to help the next generation build and ship better systems.

experience.title: Research Assistant – Computer Vision & Robotics
experience.company: AVR Research Group Makerspace Lab, UMT
experience.description: Conducting applied research in computer vision, robotics, and multimodal perception within a makerspace-driven environment, with a focus on deployable, low-latency systems for real-world use cases.
achievements: Conducting R&D on InsightVision, a hybrid YOLO/VLM pipeline targeting under 100 ms end-to-end latency for semantic natural-language querying on live video streams.
Benchmarking VLM-based adaptation against YOLO baselines to validate few-shot and zero-shot learning, aiming to reduce data annotation effort by approximately 40% for novel object classes.
Synthesizing experimental results and documenting system integration for a planned 2026 peer-reviewed research publication.
Designing and building a line-following and wall/curve-following robotic car, integrating embedded control with real-time perception for robust path tracking.

experience.title: Technical Operations, MIS & Data Associate
experience.description: Driving digital transformation and operational efficiency by managing statewide data systems, establishing official digital communication channels, and providing critical IT infrastructure support.
achievements: Spearheaded the establishment of PSDA's official digital ecosystem, configuring and managing verified accounts across Facebook, X, Instagram, and YouTube to enhance public engagement.
Resolved complex IT infrastructure challenges, including OpenVPN secure tunneling configurations, Drupal website content updates, and official government email server integration.
Streamlined MIS operations by executing rigorous data cleaning, transformation, and integrity checks on provincial vocational education datasets.
Managed official technical correspondence and documentation, acting as a key liaison for digital operations and internal team coordination.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant – Digital Logic Design

achievements: Coordinated and monitored assignment, quiz, and project submissions via the LMS, ensuring smooth assessment workflows.
Maintained grade records and tracked student progress in Excel to support data-driven academic decisions.
Ensured timely availability of lecture slides and course content, and resumed responsibilities from Oct 2025 onwards to support a new cohort.

Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills and contributed creative solutions while collaborating virtually with the engineering team.

projects.title: RULEN
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Unified Lecture Extraction Network
projects.description: AI-powered multilingual educational assistant automating lecture transcription (99+ languages), bilingual notes in Roman Urdu/Hindi & English, and curriculum-aligned quiz creation with RAG. projects.title: Freak AI
projects.subtitle: Memory-Augmented Conversational Agent

projects.title: Voice-Based Smart Attendance System
